costSummary: 40000 + 10000 per additional video, per billable minute
pricingApproach: The input schema has no billable duration parameter: measure or assume source durations for planning, but do not invent execution fields. Partial minutes are prorated. Merge rate depends on video count; summed source duration is a conservative reservation because transitions can shorten output. Extraction settles on audio output duration. The one-minute example applies only to empty design-time forms, never final execution. Missing duration measurement fails rather than charging the example.

pricingDetails.rounding: floor whole credits after prorating duration
pricingDetails.basis: source metadata for reservation; measured generated media duration for final settlement
